propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Munera, Domine, tibi dicata sanctifica: et, intercedente beato
Saturnino Martyre tuo, per haec eadem nos placatus intende. Per
Dominum.

translations.caution:
A pre-1955 lay hand missal, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its rubrics, its seasonal second and third orations, its Holy Week and its sanctoral are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

The 1861 keeps 29 November in its temporal, at the Vigil of St Andrew; leaf n530, printed p. 522, carries the commemoration's Collect, which this file already records, and leaf n531, printed p. 523, running head `29th NOVEMBER.`, carries `SECRET, of St. SATURNINUS.` with no Latin cue. It answers `Munera, Domine, tibi dicata sanctifica`. Page-image collation confirms that this historical English body answers the complete target Latin identity; publication is limited to the 1861 wording and does not claim that Cummiskey appoints the 1962 celebration.
